exposure: Women with a small-for-gestational-age infant in the subsequent pregnancy
Mode of delivery in the first pregnancy (vaginal vs. cesarean)
Mode of delivery in the first pregnancy
Low Apgar score in the first pregnancy
outcome: Recurrence of low Apgar score (<7) in the subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Women with two subsequent singleton term live births
finding: Women with birth asphyxia in their first pregnancy had twice the risk of their baby having asphyxia in their subsequent pregnancy compared to women without birth asphyxia in their first birth.
mod_finding: The recurrence risk of low Apgar score was higher for women with a previous cesarean delivery (OR 3.8) compared to those with a previous vaginal delivery (OR 2.1).
